d:
In this episode of Tarikh, we uncover the tragic and chilling story of Sarla Bhat, a 27-year-old Kashmiri Pandit nurse working at Srinagar's SKIMS Soura hospital, who was brutally abducted, tortured, and murdered by terrorists in 1990. After 36 years, the State Investigation Agency (SIA) of Jammu and Kashmir Police has filed a 737-page chargesheet in the TADA court against JKLF leader Yasin Malik and four others. Explore the dark era of terrorism in Kashmir, targeted killings, the forced exodus of Kashmiri Pandits, and the family's long, painful wait for justice.
Production: Yogesh Mishra
